sources.snippet: Overview supergemma4-26b-uncensored-gguf-v2 is a GGUF-quantized text generation model derived from Google's Gemma 4 26B instruction-tuned base, built by Jiunsong. It exports the SuperGemma Fast MLX line into GGUF Q4_K_M format for local deployment on consumer hardware, particularly Apple Silicon.
